name: Google Drive
description: Search, read, create, and copy files in Google Drive.

setupPrerequisite.title: Google Developer Preview access required
setupPrerequisite.description: Google must register both the Workspace email used to authorize Paperclip and the Google Cloud project that owns the OAuth client. Registration is limited to those emails and projects; it does not enable unrelated Paperclip customers.
steps: Apply with the Workspace email that will sign in and the Google Cloud project that owns the OAuth client.
Wait for the Google Group notification and then Google's final project-registration email, usually within a couple of days.
Add every additional tester email or Cloud project through Google's member request forms before connecting.
setupPrerequisite.actionLabel: Apply or verify Developer Preview enrollment

methods.label: Connect with Paperclip

capabilityProfile.label: Read only
capabilityProfile.description: Search and read files and metadata.

methods.whenToUse: Use Paperclip-managed OAuth for read-only Drive access.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Google Drive to search and read files. Google's Developer Preview Program must register the signed-in Workspace account and Google Cloud project before tools can run.
warnings: Before connecting, enroll the signed-in Workspace account and Google Cloud project in Google's Developer Preview Program and wait for the registration confirmation.

methods.label: Use your own Google OAuth app

capabilityProfile.label: Read only
capabilityProfile.description: Search and read files and metadata.

methods.whenToUse: Use a customer-owned OAuth client for read-only Drive access.
methods.guidanceMd: Enroll the Workspace account and Google Cloud project in Google's Developer Preview Program, enable the Drive and Drive MCP APIs, then register Paperclip's callback URI.
warnings: Before connecting, enroll the signed-in Workspace account and Google Cloud project in Google's Developer Preview Program and wait for the registration confirmation.

methods.label: Connect with Paperclip

capabilityProfile.label: Read & create
capabilityProfile.description: Read files and create or copy files.

methods.whenToUse: Use Paperclip-managed OAuth for Drive read and create access.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Google Drive to read files and create or copy app-accessible files. Google's Developer Preview Program must register the signed-in Workspace account and Google Cloud project before tools can run.
warnings: File creation and copying require approval.
Before connecting, enroll the signed-in Workspace account and Google Cloud project in Google's Developer Preview Program and wait for the registration confirmation.
